home.placeholder: Panel skeleton. The menu arrives in the next step.

mfa.codeHint: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.backupFormat: A backup code looks like XXXXXXXX-XXXX.

setup.intro: Two-factor sign-in is required for the admin panel. Set it up now — it takes a minute.
setup.scan: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password, …).
setup.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
setup.orEnter: Or enter the key by hand:
setup.enterCode: Enter the code the app shows:

codes.once: These codes are shown only once.
codes.explain: If you lose access to your authenticator app, sign in with one of these codes. Each code works once. Keep them somewhere safe.
codes.copyFailed: The browser did not allow copying — download the file.
codes.saved: I have saved the backup codes
codes.fileNote: Each code works once. Keep this file somewhere safe.

messages.invalidCode: Wrong code. Check the time on your device and try again.
messages.invalidBackupCode: Wrong or already used backup code.
messages.lockedUntil: The account is temporarily locked. Try again after {{time}}.
messages.tooManyAttempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again in about 15 minutes.
messages.accessDenied: This account has no access to the admin panel.
messages.emailNotVerified: The email address is not verified. Check your inbox.
messages.expired: This step timed out. Sign in again.
messages.mfaAlreadyEnabled: Two-factor sign-in is already on. Sign in again with a code.
messages.setupRequired: Two-factor sign-in has to be set up first. Sign in again.
messages.unavailable: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a minute.
messages.network: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection.
